brief.summary_1line: Queen Kaushalya laments Rama’s exile, condemns Kaikeyi, and mourns the imagined hardships her son, Sita, and Lakshmana now face in the forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: Queen Kaushalya sits beside the grief-stricken King Dasharatha on a couch in the dark palace, both lamenting Rama’s exile.
Kaushalya raises her hands in anguish while imagining Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana walking deep into the forest with bows and simple garments.
The queen compares herself to a cow whose calf has been seized by a lion, grieving with tear-filled eyes in the silent palace.
